review_notes: I read the whole file. Its only new definition is `Basis.HasMinimalSupport`, a predicate saying a basis minimises the support cardinality of `x` over bases with the same index type. A grep of Mathlib for "MinimalSupport" and "minimal support" found nothing relevant. The one hit, Analysis/Calculus/Deriv/Support.lean, is about derivative support and is unrelated. The proofs build on existing Mathlib pieces: `LinearEquiv.transvection`, `Basis.map`, `Basis.constr` and `Finsupp.support_erase`. They do not redefine any of them. I found no competing duplicate concept. I did not search every Mathlib file by hand, so a differently named equivalent could exist, but I saw no sign of one.
